<h2>Description</h2>

<p>Computes the ebullitive component of a gas flux during an aquatic chamber
incubation, using bubbling events detected by <code>find.bubbles</code>.
The ebullitive flux is estimated from the summed concentration steps
attributed to individual bubbling events, divided by the effective incubation
time and scaled by the flux conversion term. An independent two-point
(endpoint) estimate of the total flux is also returned for diagnostic
comparison, together with several consistency checks.
</p>


<h2>Usage</h2>

<pre><code class='language-R'>goAquaFlux.ebullition(
  df,
  gastype,
  bubbles,
  flux.term,
  final_window.min = 30,
  window_C0Cf = 10
)
</code></pre>


<h2>Arguments</h2>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="df">df</code></td>
<td>
<p>A data.frame for a single incubation. Must contain an <code>Etime</code>
column (elapsed time, seconds, starting at 0) and the gas concentration
column named by <code>gastype</code>. Rows are assumed to be sorted by
<code>Etime</code>.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="gastype">gastype</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character; name of the gas concentration column
(e.g. <code>"CH4dry_ppb"</code>).</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="bubbles">bubbles</code></td>
<td>
<p>Data.frame of bubbling events from <code>find.bubbles</code>
(or <code>NULL</code>). Must contain <code>start</code>, <code>end</code> and <code>magnitude</code>;
an optional <code>SE</code> column enables error propagation.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="flux.term">flux.term</code></td>
<td>
<p>Numeric; conversion factor turning a concentration change
per unit time into flux units (from <code>flux.term</code>).</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="final_window.min">final_window.min</code></td>
<td>
<p>Numeric; minimum time (seconds) that must remain
after the last bubble for the full deployment length to be used as the
incubation time. If less time remains, the incubation time is truncated to
the start of the last bubbling event. Default <code>30</code>.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="window_C0Cf">window_C0Cf</code></td>
<td>
<p>Numeric; duration (seconds) of the initial and final
windows used to compute mean start and end concentrations for the two-point
endpoint estimate. Default <code>10</code>.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h2>Details</h2>

<p>Ebullitive flux:
</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><code class="reqn">F_E = \frac{\sum \Delta C_{bubble}}{t_{inc}} \times K</code>
</p>

<p>with <code class="reqn">K</code> the flux conversion term and <code class="reqn">t_{inc}</code> the effective
incubation time. Standard errors are propagated assuming independent bubble
magnitude estimates:
</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><code class="reqn">SE(F_E) = \frac{K}{t_{inc}} \sqrt{\sum SE_{bubble}^2}</code>
</p>



<h2>Value</h2>

<p>A named list, always with the same fields:
</p>

<dl>
<dt>flux</dt><dd><p>Ebullitive flux (0 when no bubbles, <code>NA</code> when magnitudes
are unavailable).</p>
</dd>
<dt>SE</dt><dd><p>Standard error of the ebullitive flux (<code>NA</code> if <code>bubbles</code>
has no <code>SE</code> column).</p>
</dd>
<dt>F_tot2pts</dt><dd><p>Two-point endpoint estimate of the total flux.</p>
</dd>
<dt>F_tot2pts.SE</dt><dd><p>Standard error of the endpoint estimate.</p>
</dd>
<dt>n_bubbles</dt><dd><p>Number of bubbling events used.</p>
</dd>
<dt>deltaC_bubbles</dt><dd><p>Summed concentration increase attributed to bubbles.</p>
</dd>
<dt>deltaC_total</dt><dd><p>Observed endpoint concentration change (Cf - C0).</p>
</dd>
<dt>bubble_ratio</dt><dd><p><code>deltaC_bubbles / deltaC_total</code>.</p>
</dd>
<dt>flag_inconsistent</dt><dd><p>Logical; <code>TRUE</code> when summed bubble magnitudes
exceed the observed endpoint change.</p>
</dd>
<dt>message</dt><dd><p>Diagnostic message (<code>NA</code> when nothing to report).</p>
</dd>
</dl>

</p>
